family: The single total certificate-prefix language defined in proof.md. At actual input length N, let k be the least prime not less than the least positive B with B^5>32*N^3; read the first k bits of x as the lower coefficients of the monic degree-k polynomial Q=Z^k+sum_j q_j Z^j over F_2, and reject Q unless the exact Frobenius/gcd test proves it irreducible. Put m=N-k, K=F_2[Z]/(Q), r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Zero-pad the remaining m bits to r blocks of k bits, read block i as a_i in K in the polynomial basis, and output the constant coefficient of the sum over t-element subsets I of the product over i in I of a_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1). Output 0 for N=0, for m<=0, and whenever a guard fails. The k prefix bits are part of the input and counted in N; Q is not advice.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses. Fix any valid prefix Q. For every integer N>=2^20 with k,r,t as above, 1<=t<r and k*t>=r(r+1), and disperser.md proves the payload function is nonconstant on every affine subspace of dimension greater than d(N)=floor(k*r/t)+k*t+r(r+1). Fixing the prefix in a circuit for F_N leaves a circuit with the same gate count for a function on m=N-k bits that is nonconstant on every affine subspace of dimension greater than d(N), so elimination.md gives C_B2(F_N)>=4m-9(d(N)+1)=4N-R(N) with R(N)=4k+9(floor(k*r/t)+k*t+r(r+1)+1). Here k<4*N^(3/5)+2, r<N^(2/5)/2+1 and sqrt(r)<=t<=sqrt(r)+1, so d(N) and R(N) are O(N^(4/5)); in fact R(N)<=58*N^(4/5). Hence liminf over integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4: for every epsilon>0, N_epsilon=max(2^20,ceil((58/epsilon)^5)) gives C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)*N for every integer N>=N_epsilon.
